definition: Width and melt of edges, independent of highlight glow.

not_the_same_as.vec_bokeh_softness: Bokeh softness is the out-of-focus field. Edge softness can sit on an in-focus subject.
not_the_same_as.vec_diffusion: Diffusion is a veil over the whole field. Edge softness is contour width.
not_the_same_as.vec_optical_softness: Optical softness includes highlight spread and micro-detail melt, not only edge width.

observable_effects: hair and fabric edges lose snap
open_questions: Is there any prompt that thickens contours without defocusing the subject?

prompt_phrases.high: heavy edge softness only: wide melted contours, dissolved outlines, highlight cores remain tight, no haze
prompt_phrases.low: razor-hard contours, high acutance, no edge melt, tight subject outline
prompt_phrases.medium: slightly widened edges, mild contour melt, highlight cores still tight

scoring_guidance: 0.00 razor edges, 0.50 mild contour melt, 1.00 wide melted outlines.
testable_claim: Increasing edge softness thickens and dissolves contours without requiring a veil, highlight spread, or background disk melt.
